Introducing Idira ® , the only platform that seamlessly integrates modern privilege access management (PAM), machine and agentic identity security capabilities. Challenges Uncontrolled privileges. Explosive growth. Unmanaged risk. Legacy identity solutions were built for yesterday's problems, where elevated privileges were reserved for a select few. Now, all identities need broad privileges, leaving you vulnerable to identity breaches. 96% of human users have access beyond what is required. 109:1 machines outnumber human identities. 99 out of 100 organizations have adopted AI agents. jobs.description: Early Careers at Palo Alto Networks Skip to main content Early In Career Launch a legendary career. We disrupt the cybersecurity status quo by challenging the way things are done - we are looking for incredible talent to help us do that. In return, you will have a valuable career at Palo Alto Networks working with technology that protects thousands of lives . Transform our future. Our early-in-career programs will train you to be a part of the next generation of cybersecurity talent. Whether technical or non-technical, we have a place for you! Join us to tackle challenging projects, grow your professional network, and expand your knowledge in a fast-paced environment. Internship Program Join us this summer. Our 12-week program will challenge, support, and excite you as you explore your future career path. Technical and non-technical roles available Exposure to and support from Palo Alto Networks executives Development events that foster your career growth Community events with an elite intern cohort to expand your professional network Opportunities to work on meaningful projects that impact a global cybersecurity leader Consistent support from your manager, your mentors, and the Early Talent team every step of the way Search Internship Openings Emerging Professionals Launch your career in cybersecurity, no matter your path. You've put in the hard work—whether through a degree, a bootcamp, or self-learning. Now, as you look to the future, it's natural to feel both excited and unsure. We're here to help you navigate the next steps on your path to success. Leap ProGRAM Training programs that open doors. The year-long, global LEAP Program is made up of technical and non-technical professionals committed to protecting our digital way of life. We equip you with knowledge and skills to excel in your career through: An early-in-career community Social events to build your network Access to mentors and support from the Early Talent Team Exposure to and support from executive leadership Professional development events that help you navigate your career Areas We Hire Secure Your Place in a High-Impact Career. Step into cybersecurity using your strengths in engineering or sales. You don't need security expertise—just your skills and a passion for making a difference. Product Development Product Engineering Product Management DevOps and QA Security Research Sales Sales Engineering Inside Sales Security Consultants ACADEMIES Take your skills up a notch. Each of our academies falls under the LEAP Program to provide additional training in key job areas. Entry-level opportunities follow specialized tracks for Unit 42 Consulting, Product Management, Sales and Systems Engineering. Unit 42 Academy A year-long accelerated academy designed to develop Associate Consultants into successful Unit 42 Consultants. The academy covers Digital Forensics & Incident Response (DFIR), Governance Risk & Compliance (GRC), and Offensive Security (OffSec). Product Management Academy An accelerated academy that develops early-in-career PMs into experienced PMs. Early-in-career PMs ramp up through a specific program curriculum and two twelve-month rotations: each with a different product, manager, and team. Inside Sales Academy A year-long academy designed to arm early-in-Career Business Development Representatives with sales skills such as prospecting, lead generation, and business etiquette. We develop world-class sales representatives that connect customers to our solutions. Sales Engineering Academy A two-year-long, accelerated academy designed to arm emerging professionals with critical skills and knowledge to be successful Sales Engineers at Palo Alto Networks. jobs.description: Military and Veteran Cybersecurity Careers, Jobs at Palo Alto Networks Skip to main content Military and Veterans Continue protecting our way of life. Resources for those who have served. At Palo Alto Networks, our values of disruption, execution, collaboration, integrity, and inclusion guide everything we do in protecting our digital way of life. These values are also deeply held principles of the women and men who have proudly represented our Armed Services. Fundamental to who we are is the shared vision of a world where each and every day is safer and more secure than the one that came before it. So, it is by design that hiring Veterans is critical to our success . Enjoy limitless opportunities to grow with a great team. Laramie feels lucky that he was able to leverage his military experience in a leading organization that's 'always first' in the industry. Discover how your unique experiences can lead to an exciting position with us. Veterans' leadership, adaptability, problem solving, teamwork, and commitment help drive our customers to a safer digital future. At Palo Alto Networks, Veterans have found a new mission in cybersecurity, shifting from battlefields to the latest, most demanding threats of our age. Our philosophy starts with our board members and executives and continues through our recruiting teams with everyone committed to hiring and developing Veterans across all business functions. And as a proud Military Friendly ® Employer, founded by military Veterans, we've formed our Veterans Program to help Veterans and transitioning service members foster new skills and enjoy successful careers in cybersecurity. Uncover your next mission. View All Jobs Senior Director, Network Security & 5G Go-To-Market Programs I was drawn to the opportunity to drive growth in strategic markets and bring exciting new technologies to customers. The desire to pursue this opportunity only increased throughout the interview process when I learned, through employees' eyes, how Palo Alto Networks created an environment that enables employee empowerment to make an impact in the business and personal areas of passion. Tiffany Henry Intelligence Specialist Second Class Petty Officer U.S. Navy Distribution Sales Specialist I was drawn to Palo Alto Networks because of its mission to protect our digital way of life. Similarly to my experiences on the battlefield, I believe we are making a difference. I've had the opportunity to be mentored by outstanding leadership while being challenged to be my very best. The culture, people, and technology are unmatched. I am proud to be a Marine Corps Veteran at Palo Alto Networks! Lorence Ayag Instructor, The Officer Candidate School 1st Battalion, 7th Marines United States Marine Corps Strategic PM of U.S. Fed Gov Public Sector GTM I am proud to be a Latina and a Veteran in cybersecurity. In the Navy, I led an exciting counterterrorism and national security career which allowed me to transition to cybersecurity. Today, I have translated my military experience to serve the Palo Alto Networks federal customer base on the Public Sector team, and continue to educate the LatinX community on the benefits of a military career. Angela H. PMP: Imagery/Geospatial Intelligence Analyst Petty Officer First Class U.S. Navy Military Friendly ® Employer. Veterans' leadership, adaptability, teamwork, and commitment help drive our customers to a safer digital future. Our Veterans have found a new mission in cybersecurity, shifting from battlefields to the latest, most demanding threats of our age. TRANSITION PROGRAMS DoD SkillBridge program. DoD SkillBridge program allows retiring and transitioning service members to participate in industry training programs while transitioning out of their military careers. VETERAN STORIES From our CEO, Nikesh Arora As the son of a late Indian Air Force officer, I have a deep and personal regard for those who serve in the military. When I think about the increasingly complex cybersecurity challenges that governments and industries face, I know that Veterans – many of whom bring specialized training and expertise into their civilian careers – will be a critical resource for Palo Alto Networks. We remain committed to engaging, supporting, training, and hiring Veterans across the world. VETERAN EMPLOYMENT SUPPORTER Recognized in Australia. Palo Alto Networks has been recognised as a Veteran Employment Supporter under the Australian Department of Veterans’ Affairs Veteran Employment Commitment. This marks our public pledge to support Veterans as they transition from military to civilian life — by fostering a workplace where their skills, leadership, and experience are valued and where they can thrive.
